title: Renovation Deployment Board
subtitle: Arrange, run, and recover a fictional drone-enabled project system
introTitle: Make the deployment work when the project refuses to stay still.
introBody: Schedule four connected activities across the renovation windows, route their information to a responsible project node, then run the live board. A site-access change will interrupt the plan and require physical reconfiguration.
provisional: Developed M4.2 learning material is not yet available. All capacities and consequences are fictional scenario values.
objective: Objective: produce a traceable renovation review package while respecting access and limited project capacity.
timelineHint: Select or drag an activity into a window. Several activities can share a window, but resources and dependencies still apply.
selected: Activity selected · choose a window or responsibility node
routesHint: Select an activity, then connect its output to the project node responsible for receiving it.
changeBody: Courtyard access closes during Window 3 and reopens in Window 4. The board is paused: move the courtyard activity and rebalance anything displaced before resuming.
changeHint: A stable recovery moves Controlled data handoff into Window 3 and Courtyard visual check into Window 4.
reason.route: Data stopped because its receiving responsibility was missing or wrong.
reason.access: Courtyard access was unavailable in this project window.
reason.resource: More flight activity was scheduled than the fictional kit capacity supports.
reason.dependency: Required earlier project information was not available.
completePass: Deployment stabilised after the project change.
completeFail: The simulated project finished with blocked work.
completePassBody: All four activities ran, their information reached the intended project nodes, and the access change was recovered through a real schedule rebalance.
completeFailBody: At least one activity or data flow failed. Revise the board and run the project again to see whether the system recovers.
scenarioNote: All displayed capacities are fictional scenario values, not professional benchmarks.
